messages.text:
I get excited just by
coming to Small Court!!{be01}

Just by being here! Just by watching it!
I get really excited!{be01}
If I played a game here,
I would be extremely excited!

We don't want to have
a one-on-two battle.

We had a battle with Pokémon
in the stadium...{be01}
I am happy 'cause I experienced
what star players feel!

One-on-two?
We cannot fight like that.
